name: foundryvtt
description: Foundry VTT toolkit. live-test starts Foundry and tries a module, macro or automation change in the world as Gamemaster and as a Test Player, on throwaway actors, logging problems to a report instead of fixing mid-wave. condense-scenes-to-levels merges a map split one scene per floor into one scene with v14 Levels. rig-hazard-region sets off the Multitrap DMG hazards and traps from a region through Midi.
